svg.title: Hi, I'm Lakshit Singh — developer profile
svg.desc: A complete terminal-style profile containing introduction, projects, tools and interests.
svg.text: lakshit@github: ~/profile
$ whoami
Hi, I'm Lakshit Singh :)
Computer Science student · India · Builder · Curious mind
$ cat about.txt
I'm a Computer Science student from India who loves building things and exploring what technology can do.
I often find myself going down rabbit holes, experimenting with new ideas, or starting a project
just because something caught my attention.
I'm interested in a lot of things, especially AI, desktop applications, developer tools, web development,
and product development. I don't really want to limit myself to one field. There's always something new
to explore, something different to learn, or a better way to build something.
What excites me most is taking an idea that exists only in my head and slowly turning it into something
real. I enjoy every part of that process, from figuring out what to build and how it should work to
writing the code and seeing everything come together.
And it's not always about technology. I spend my time exploring gaming, space, music, and psychology,
too. I like learning about things that make me curious, even when they have nothing to do with what
I'm building.
I have plenty of ideas I'd love to bring to life. Someday, I want to build products that people around
the world genuinely enjoy using. Until then, you'll probably find me working on something new,
experimenting with an idea, or getting curious about something completely different.
$ ls ./some-things-ive-built
01 SORTIFY DESKTOP
A Windows desktop app that helps organise files without the usual manual sorting. It scans file contents
and suggests meaningful names, so folders are easier to manage.
You can review suggestions before applying them, inspect file details, and undo changes when needed.
02 FACILITYFIX
A campus facility issue reporting system where students can report problems instead of having to chase
them manually.
It gives coordinators a place to review reports, manage their status, and keep track of issues through to resolution.
03 PUSTAKALAYA LMS
A library management system designed to bring everyday library work into one place. It keeps track of
books, copies, members, and circulation.
It also covers reservations, fines, and reports, with a local-first setup for managing library records.
04 VEYLO
A habit tracker built to make daily routines easier to follow. It brings habits, planning, and progress
into a simple personal space.
The focus is on keeping things straightforward and making it easy to see how you're doing over time.
05 SABUDDY
An Android app for organising social media content, from early ideas to captions and scripts. It helps
keep content planning in one workspace.
It includes calendar and saved-content workflows, with optional Gemini support for AI-assisted creation.
$ echo "More Coming Soon"
There are always a few ideas in progress. I'll add them here as they turn into something worth sharing.
